[[File:Gravity_hook.jpg|thumb|200px|Gravity hook on Makeb]]
'''Gravity hooks''' were orbital stations connected to a [[Planet/Legends|planet's]] surface by incredibly long [[Turbolift/Legends|turbolift]] shafts and [[Repulsorlift/Legends|repulsorlifts]]. The stations were limited in use to the purposes of industrial transportation, due to low speed, small transport capacity, and high energy costs.<ref name="CodexGrav" /> Gravity hooks consisted of loading rings fixed to the surface and docking rings at the top of the turbolifts.<ref name="TOR" />

Gravity hooks were in use on the planet [[Makeb]],<ref name="CodexGrav">{{TORcite|exp=rothc|type=codex|Gravity Hooks}}</ref> as its hazardous atmospheric conditions caused electromagnetic interference that posed a danger to flight. Cargo could not be transported by usual means, as the atmospheric anomalies destroyed vessels larger than personal shuttles.<ref name="CodexAtmo">{{TORcite|exp=rothc|type=codex|Atmosphere of Makeb}}</ref> In order to transport valuable minerals extracted from Makeb's mesas,<ref name="CodexMine">{{TORcite|exp=rothc|type=codex|Mining on Makeb}}</ref> mining corporations from the planet constructed gravity hooks in order to circumvent this issue, and successfully created an alternative for the transportation of cargo offworld.<ref name="CodexGrav" /> The gravity hooks present on Makeb included [[Gravity Hook Four]] and [[Gravity Hook Seven]].<ref name="TOR">{{TORcite|exp=rothc|type=other|[[Makeb]]}}</ref>

By [[3638 BBY]],<ref name="Date">{{TOR_updates|2.0}}</ref> many gravity hooks on Makeb had fallen into disuse, corresponding with an increase in modifications to [[Starship/Legends|starships]] that allowed for safer [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmospheric]] flight.<ref name="CodexGrav" />

Gravity hooks were similar in purpose and concept to [[Skyhook/Legends|skyhooks]].

==Behind the scenes==
Gravity hooks bare strong resemblance to the concept of [[Wikipedia:Space elevator|space elevators]] in science fiction and real life, although proposed real-life space elevators use tethers rather than the fixed turbolifts used by gravity hooks.
